subject: Motocross procedural mechanics, soil morphology, loaded-wheel pickup and solo landing targets
summary: Production build, static checks and all 3564 distinct current unit cases passed across the broad run plus documented process-access and late-grid runs. Seven final scoped browser checks passed, with actual game flow at Low on a software GPU. This is not a consumer-hardware performance or photographic realism certification.

landingTargets.method: One run per fixed approach speed in solo Sport practice, on fresh live deformable terrain. Manual eligibility begins 12 m before the face with autoPlayer=false and aiControlled(0). After initial placement/speed/gear, only public ground/air controls are scripted. Actual production Float32 snapshots feed the live assessment and MotocrossLandingChallenge. No speed search or physical tuning. Scripted feasibility does not establish human ease or a full route from the start gate.
landingTargets.scopeLimit: Scripted controller uses the production landing forecast from a fixed rolling approach. These are actual tracker-earned targets, not proof of human ease, a complete manual lap, or exhaustive controller tuning.

wheelPickup.method: Real surveyed RIDGE TABLE flight; 0.4 s front brake from airTime 0.2 s, existing pitch-control pedals, then coast 0.3 s. Reference uses same physical definition via unchanged general adapter. Simulation rates are measured separately; not runtime FPS.
wheelPickup.scopeLimit: Finite pickup of inherited airborne wheel mismatch is layered over the existing rolling core. These examples are not universal speed penalties and do not validate a complete tyre/drivetrain solver.

offroadCalibration.method: Run the existing scripts/offroad-calibration.ts from a scratch copy with only imports/report output redirected.

fixedSeedRaces.method: Run the existing scripts/offroad-races.ts cases separately for MX and SX with only scratch import/report paths redirected. This does not claim the complete npm run test:offroad command was executed.

references.qualification: Review classifications are not feature counts. Screenshots do not measure friction, inertia, thresholds, or establish their capture platform. No supplied screenshot is shipped as a texture.

evidenceStorage: This committed record preserves measured summaries and raw-report digests. Full browser outputs, screenshots and exploratory reports are temporary session evidence, not committed game assets.
limitations: The scene and rider retain a procedural appearance; this pass improves specific mechanical/material behavior without claiming photographic or AAA parity.
No consumer-GPU FPS or Medium/High full-game performance certification; the full-game functional pass used Low on SwiftShader.
Scripted target feasibility and AI race completion do not establish beginner difficulty or human fun through playtesting.
The wheel correction does not replace the entire rolling-core tyre/drivetrain model; a subsequent insignificant hop still follows the pre-existing hop touchdown path.
No deployment, APK release or hosted production performance check is part of this validation.
